code.module:
# SETTINGS: the WiFi networks that every Copper and Code app on this board uses.
#
# Up to five networks are kept by cac_settings in cac_settings.json in the flash, from the most
# recently used. boot.py connects to the best one in range at power-on; the other apps call
# cac_settings.connect() when they need the network. Here they are added, chosen, tried and
# forgotten. Scanning and connecting take seconds, so a touch only asks for them and the timer
# runs them on its next tick, after the screen has shown "Connecting...".
import cac_settings

UNSELECTED = 0x1B2838
SELECTED = 0x4FA3FF
DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS = 70

sta = cac_settings.station()
job = None
selected = None             # the saved network chosen on Networks
picked = None               # the network chosen on Add


def row_buttons():
    return (ui.net1, ui.net2, ui.net3, ui.net4, ui.net5)


def button_text(button, text):
    button.get_child(0).set_text(text)


def saved_names():
    return [n["ssid"] for n in cac_settings.networks()]


def show_networks():
    global selected
    saved = saved_names()
    if selected not in saved:
        selected = saved[0] if saved else None
    current = cac_settings.connected_ssid(sta)
    for i, button in enumerate(row_buttons()):
        if i < len(saved):
            name = saved[i]
            button_text(button, name + ("   connected" if name == current else ""))
            button.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(SELECTED if name == selected else UNSELECTED), 0)
            button.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
        else:
            button.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    if not saved:
        ui.status.set_text("No network saved: touch Add")
    elif sta is None:
        ui.status.set_text("No WiFi in the simulator: networks are saved only")
    elif current:
        ui.status.set_text("Connected to " + current)
    else:
        ui.status.set_text("Not connected")


def choose_row(index):
    global selected
    saved = saved_names()
    if index < len(saved):
        selected = saved[index]
        show_networks()


def forget_selected():
    global selected
    if selected:
        cac_settings.forget(selected)
        selected = None
    show_networks()


def start_connect():
    global job
    if not selected:
        return
    if sta is None:
        ui.status.set_text("No WiFi in the simulator")
        return
    ui.status.set_text("Connecting to " + selected + "...")
    job = "connect"


def do_connect():
    secret = cac_settings.password(selected)
    if cac_settings.join(selected, secret, sta):
        cac_settings.remember(selected, secret)
        show_networks()
    else:
        ui.status.set_text("Could not connect to " + selected)


def open_add():
    global picked, job
    picked = None
    ui.password.set_text("")
    ui.keyboard.set_textarea(ui.password)
    ui.keyboard.set_align(lv.ALIGN.TOP_LEFT)    # a keyboard is aligned to the bottom by LVGL
    ui.keyboard.set_pos(0, lv.screen_active().get_height() - ui.keyboard.get_height())
    ui.scan_list.clean()
    ui.add_status.set_text("Looking for networks...")
    job = "scan"


def start_scan():
    global job
    ui.add_status.set_text("Looking for networks...")
    job = "scan"


def pick(name):
    global picked
    picked = name
    secret = cac_settings.password(name)
    ui.password.set_text(secret or "")
    ui.add_status.set_text(name + (": saved, password filled in" if secret is not None else ": type the password"))


def do_scan():
    try:
        found = cac_settings.scan(sta)
    except OSError as e:
        print("scan:", repr(e))
        ui.add_status.set_text("WiFi not available")
        return
    saved = saved_names()
    box = ui.scan_list
    box.clean()
    for name, rssi in found:
        b = lv.button(box)                     # the list lays its children out in a column
        b.set_size(lv.pct(100), 38)
        b.set_style_radius(4, 0)
        b.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(UNSELECTED), 0)
        label = lv.label(b)
        label.set_text(name + ("   saved" if name in saved else ""))
        label.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0xF2F5F9), 0)
        label.center()
        b.add_event_cb(lambda e, n=name: pick(n), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)
    ui.add_status.set_text("Touch a network" if found else "No network in range")


def start_save():
    global job
    if not picked:
        ui.add_status.set_text("Touch a network first")
        return
    ui.add_status.set_text("Connecting to " + picked + "...")
    job = "save"


def do_save():
    global selected
    secret = ui.password.get_text()
    if sta is not None and not cac_settings.join(picked, secret, sta):
        ui.add_status.set_text("Could not connect: check the password")
        return
    cac_settings.remember(picked, secret)
    selected = picked
    ui.load_page(ui.PAGE_NETWORKS)


def backlight(level):
    try:
        import display_driver
    except ImportError:
        return
    if hasattr(display_driver, "backlight"):          # the simulator has no backlight
        display_driver.backlight(level)


def show_brightness(level):
    ui.bright_text.set_text("Brightness %d%%" % level)


def open_display():
    level = cac_settings.section("display").get("brightness", DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS)
    ui.bright.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(UNSELECTED), lv.PART.MAIN)    # the track, visible
    ui.bright.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER, lv.PART.MAIN)
    ui.bright.set_value(level, False)
    show_brightness(level)


def change_brightness():
    level = ui.bright.get_value()
    show_brightness(level)
    backlight(level)


def save_brightness():
    """Written when the finger leaves the slider, not at every step: the flash wears out."""
    display = cac_settings.section("display")
    display["brightness"] = ui.bright.get_value()
    cac_settings.set_section("display", display)


def on_tick():
    global job
    current, job = job, None
    if current == "connect":
        do_connect()
    elif current == "scan":
        do_scan()
    elif current == "save":
        do_save()
